job.title: Brand & Identity Designer (Fresher)
job.description: Crescent Collective is a boutique branding studio in Bengaluru working with early-stage startups across India and Southeast Asia. We are hiring a fresher Brand & Identity Designer who can craft compelling visual identities — logos, colour systems, typeface selection, and brand guidelines. A strong sense of aesthetics, attention to detail, and the ability to present and defend design decisions to clients are essential. You will work directly with the studio's creative director on 3-5 projects simultaneously.

pool.text: Adobe Illustrator: created 15 logo concepts across wordmark, lettermark and pictorial mark styles for college design competition; 2 concepts selected for real-world use
Brand guidelines: authored a 24-page brand book for a college startup covering logo usage, colour palette, typeface rules, do's and don'ts
TeaKraft: brand identity project for a fictional artisanal tea brand — logo, packaging mockups, social media templates, and 20-page brand guide; won Best Branding Project at institute design festival
Colour theory: competent in defining 60-30-10 palettes, complementary and analogous schemes, and testing across print and digital contexts
Typography: selected and paired serif/sans-serif systems for 6 brand identities; comfortable with optical sizing and variable fonts
Brand Design Intern at Tandem Studio (Mumbai, 3 months): assisted senior designer on 4 logo projects, produced packaging mockup renders in Photoshop and prepared client presentation decks
Mockup rendering in Photoshop: realistic product and stationery mockups for client presentations using smart objects
B.Des Graphic Design, Pearl Academy Delhi, 2022–2026, Distinction
Client presentation: delivered 8 brand concept presentations to real and simulated clients with structured storytelling — brief, insight, concept rationale, application
EcoRoots: brand identity for a sustainable fashion startup — crafted earthy palette, custom hand-drawn logotype in Illustrator, and product hang-tag design
Docker Compose: set up a local development environment for a web project using Docker Compose; not related to design work
Figma: used for collaborative multi-page brand presentation files and social media template systems
InDesign: laid out multi-page brand books and editorial-style documents with master pages and paragraph styles
Shell scripting: wrote a Bash script to automate renaming exported asset files; occasional personal tool use
